meta.title: What UnLitigate Does — UnLitigate
meta.description: Three parts, one aim: make mediation something people think of first. Awareness is live. A supervised student-mediator pilot is starting in Bhubaneswar and Pune.

hero.heading: Three parts, one aim
hero.body: Make mediation something people think of first. Here is what is live and what is coming.

items.heading: Awareness and enquiries
items.body: Reels, posts, this site. We explain mediation in plain language and take enquiries from people who want to understand their options.

items.heading: Supervised student mediators
items.body: Training and supervision for students who will facilitate suitable disputes in Bhubaneswar and Pune.

items.heading: Referral partnerships
items.body: Working toward links with university mediation centres, so people can be referred to a trusted room.

map.heading: Where we are
map.body: This is where we are. Soft marks elsewhere stand for people who may be about to give up on a dispute — not real cases, and not a count.
map.caption: Illustrative. Not data about real people or places.

safeguards.heading: Safeguards
safeguards.subheading: For centres, universities and lawyers — and for anyone who needs to know how we work.

items.heading: Supervision
items.body: Student mediators work under a registered mediator / legal aid clinic. The named supervisor will be listed here once confirmed.

items.heading: We take
items.body: Suitable business, family and property disputes — where both sides can sit down, and where talking can still help.

items.heading: We don't take
items.body: Violence, fraud, or criminal matters. Those need a different door.

items.heading: Settlements
items.body: When people agree, it is written down and signed by both sides.

items.heading: Confidentiality and consent
items.body: No one is forced into the room. What is said is treated as confidential, with the usual limits of the law.

whyNow.heading: Why now
whyNow.body: India's Mediation Act 2023 put mediation on a clearer legal footing. The Mediation Council of India was set up in August 2026. We want to work alongside that shift — helping ordinary people hear about the option, in language that does not feel like a courtroom.

cta.heading: Ready to explore your options?
cta.body: Tell us what's happening. We will help you see whether mediation may suit you.
